requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) Explain to your counselor the most likely hazards you may encounter while participating in water sports activities and what you should do to anticipate, help prevent, mitigate, and respond to these hazards. (b) Review prevention, symptoms, and first-aid treatment for the following injuries or illnesses that could occur while participating in water sports: blisters, cold-water shock and hypothermia, dehydration, heat-related illnesses, sunburn, sprains, strains, minor cuts and bruises, spinal injury, and concussions and head trauma. (c) Review the Scouting America Safety Afloat policy. Tell how it applies to water sports.

Then demonstrate how to select and fit a life jacket for water sports activities. (b) Review and discuss the Water Sports Safety Code with your counselor. Promise that you will live up to it and follow it in all water work for this merit badge. Review the safety precautions that must be used by the boat operator in pulling waterskiers and wakeboarders.

pamphlet_excerpts: Water Sports Sub-Req 5a: Show how to enter the water from a boat and make a deepwater start without help.
Water Sports Sub-Req 5b: Starting from outside the wakes, show you can cross both wakes four times and return to the center of the wake each time, without falling.
Water Sports Sub-Req 5c: Show you can fall properly to avoid an obstacle. Also show that you can drop handle and coast to a stop without losing your balance.

Core Standard 1 (Req 5): Showing reasonable control while using two skis, one ski, or a wakeboard, do the following: (a) Show how to enter the water from a boat and make a deepwater start without help.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 5): Review the official Water Sports requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Showing reasonable control while using two skis, one.
Execute & Document: Perform the show task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Water Sports Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.
